title: Effective arbitrage interval
framing: dt_eff is of order 1 to 3 s; the per-hour estimate is very sensitive to the band (a 1 bp shift in the reference price moves weeks 4-5 from ~13 s to ~3-4.5 s). clim's posted fee does not depend on dt: eta is calibrated at equal average fee, so only eta*sqrt(dt/2) matters.

title: Volatility window
framing: At equal time-average fee, clim's 5-minute rule and the keeper are comparable: -4.4 % arbitrage loss with arbitrage every second, +4.6 % every 15 s; clim charges 11.96 bp per dollar traded vs the keeper's 10.77 bp. Not a claim of better fees.

title: Volatility estimator
framing: binance-1s scored best in-sample by 1.09 points on a simulator driven by the same Binance path; it is excluded because the desk must not depend on one venue (spec §3); venue-range is the best multi-venue estimator.

title: Per-direction signal
framing: Trades toward the venue capture the stale pool's gap (signal correlates 0.93 with the pre-trade gap and 0.04 with the later move); the premium rule clears its gate on the five weeks pooled but in only 3 of 5 weeks; measured, experimental, not deployed on ETH/USDG (its hook is symmetric).
